description_en: Call DescribeUserErStatus to check whether Edge Routine (ER) is enabled or has an overdue payment
description_zh: 调用DescribeUserErStatus查看边缘函数ER是否开通或者欠费
name: DescribeUserErStatus

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether Edge Routine (ER) is enabled.

true: The service is enabled.
false: The service is not enabled
Enabled.description_zh:
是否开通边缘函数ER。

true：开通。
false：未开通

InDebt.description_en:
Indicates whether the Edge Routine (ER) service has an overdue payment.

true: An overdue payment exists.
false: No overdue payment exists
InDebt.description_zh:
边缘函数ER是否欠费。

true：欠费。
false：未欠费

InDebtOverdue.description_en:
Indicates whether the grace period for an overdue payment has expired.

true: The grace period has expired.
false: The grace period has not expired
InDebtOverdue.description_zh:
边缘函数ER是否欠费超时。

true：超时。
false：未超时

OnService.description_en:
Indicates whether Edge Routine (ER) is active.

true: The service is active.
false: The service is not active
OnService.description_zh:
边缘函数ER是否可用。

true：可用。
false：不可用
